payload.title: File:Eosphorosuchus lacrimosa (holotype skull, YPM VP 41198).png
payload.artist_html: M. Margulis-Ohnuma, A. A. Ruebenstahl, D. L. Meyer & B.-A. S. Bhullar
payload.credit_html: "A short-snouted 'sphenosuchian' with unusual feeding anatomy demonstrates that ecological specialization occurred early in crocodylomorph evolution"
payload.description_html: Photographs and line drawings of the skull of Eosphorosuchus lacrimosa as preserved and prepared in right ventrolateral view (a, c) and left dorsolateral view (b, d). Grey shading represents matrix or bones of other individuals; halftone represents areas of breakage. Abbreviations: an, angular; e, ectopterygoid; f, frontal; j, jugal; l, lacrimal; m, maxilla; n, nasal; pa, prearticular; pb, palpebral; pl, palatine; pm, premaxilla; po, postorbital; pt, pterygoid; sa, surangular; tpt, transverse process of the pterygoid. Scale bar is 2 cm.
